subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable reasoning presentation, with each channel plugin owning its supported display modes and fallback behavior?
rationale: Source proves the capability is missing, but adding a public config surface and deciding cross-channel semantics, ownership, and precedence requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Channel plugin contract
options.body: Add plugin-owned presentation modes with explicit capability mapping and preserve existing italic output as the compatibility default.

options.title: Global agent setting
options.body: Add one agent-wide mode and require every reasoning-capable channel and non-channel surface to implement consistent semantics.

options.title: Retain fixed presentation
options.body: Avoid new configuration and address only concrete readability or renderer defects through a single maintained default.

recommendation.title: Channel plugin contract
recommendation.body: Add plugin-owned presentation modes with explicit capability mapping and preserve existing italic output as the compatibility default.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the presentation behavior, has substantial recent reasoning-path history, and already reviewed this issue as needing a maintainer decision.
